subject: prd/contract-gate
statement: When planning is invoked for a feature, the planner shall call the gate on that feature's assembled contract and shall not draft, freeze, or project any plan unless the gate returns a clean verdict.
rationale: the gate is the planning-entry hard stop; a broken contract must not reach decomposition
fit_criterion: on fixtures, a planning invocation against a bouncing contract produces zero draft/plan output and surfaces the defect report; against a clean contract, planning proceeds
